results.title: Control: contract FULL-ACCESS key + pinned WASM + game secrets, signed outside the contract code
results.expected: secrets released (same predecessor, right hash) → shows 05a/05b got no secret because of the WasmHash binding alone
results.actual: execution_completed success=true; derived season-1 pubkey matches get_season_pubkey(1); contract has 1 FullAccess key(s)
results.finding: F1: osd contract account still has a FullAccess key. Its holder passes the keystore Predecessor rule (can run the referee against stored ciphertexts out of band: a prompt-probing oracle) and can call #[private] on_match/on_pubkey (forge results). Fix: delete the full-access key after deploy (locked contract), or move upgrades behind a DAO/multisig.

results.title: Withhold the reveal after seeing the opponent (classic commit-reveal attack)
results.expected: n/a: there is no reveal step to withhold
results.actual: n/a. commit stores the ECIES ciphertext itself (season 1 entry clique-amber: 542 B on chain); only the TEE (season key from PROTECTED_SEASON_SEED) decrypts it, at play time, without the player. Nothing to withhold after commit; the commit is final (no overwrite). The nearest levers: commit garbage → F + bond lost (attack 8); refuse to enter → no stake; void a match by starving play_match gas → see 13.
